_comment: Publication-gate thresholds and the remediation skip list. Versioned so every change is a reviewed diff — the env-var valves this file replaced (SS_SKIP_ISSUE_CODES, SS_REPAIR_SHIFT_SHARE) let thresholds loosen without leaving a trace. Rationale for each number lives beside its consumer in mapgen/validation.py and mapgen/cli.py. skip_issue_codes must stay empty on main.
